drafts.passage: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a mean BLEU of 28.4 ± 0.6 over 8 seeds, compared to 27.6 ± 0.8 for Varrow-NMT. This corresponds to a mean BLEU advantage of 0.8 points for Tessaline over Varrow-NMT, but no statistical test was reported for this specific comparison, so the difference cannot be characterized as significant. Tessaline also outperformed the PhraseGrid baseline by a statistically significant margin (mean paired BLEU difference 6.35, 95% CI [5.87, 6.83], paired t-test p < 0.001).
